title: Two Sum (Basic)
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to target.

title: Reverse String
statement: Write a function that returns the characters of a string in reverse order.

title: Valid Parentheses
statement: Return true if the bracket string is balanced and false otherwise.

title: Maximum Subarray
statement: Return the largest sum of any contiguous subarray.

title: Palindrome Number
statement: Return true when a number reads the same forward and backward.

title: Merge Sorted Arrays
statement: Merge two sorted arrays into one sorted array.
starter_code:
def merge_sorted_arrays(first, second):
    return sorted(first + second)

title: Binary Search
statement: Return the index of target in a sorted array or -1 if it is missing.

title: First Unique Character
statement: Return the first index whose character appears only once.

title: Majority Element
statement: Return the element that appears more than half the time.

title: Move Zeroes
statement: Move all zeroes to the end while keeping the order of non-zero values.
starter_code:
def move_zeroes(nums):
    return [n for n in nums if n != 0] + [0] * nums.count(0)

title: Anagram Check
statement: Return true if both strings use the same characters with the same counts.

title: Intersection of Arrays
statement: Return the distinct numbers present in both arrays, sorted ascending.
starter_code:
def intersection_arrays(first, second):
    return sorted(list(set(first) & set(second)))

title: Missing Number
statement: Given numbers from 0 to n with one missing, return the missing value.

title: Climb Stairs
statement: Return how many ways there are to climb n steps when you can take 1 or 2 steps.

title: Fibonacci Sequence
statement: Return the n-th Fibonacci number with F(0)=0 and F(1)=1.

title: Factorial
statement: Return n! for a non-negative integer n.

title: Sum Digits
statement: Return the sum of all digits in a non-negative integer.

title: Fizz Buzz
statement: Return FizzBuzz numbers from 1 to n using the standard rules.

title: Rotate Array
statement: Rotate an array to the right by k steps.

title: Remove Duplicates
statement: Return the array after removing duplicate values while keeping the first occurrence.

title: Running Sum
statement: Return the prefix sums of the input array.
starter_code:
def running_sum(nums):
    total = 0
    result = []
    for num in nums:
        total += num
        result.append(total)
    return result

title: Range Sum
statement: Return the sum of the values from index l to r inclusive.
starter_code:
def range_sum(nums, l, r):
    return sum(nums[l:r + 1])

title: Sorted Squares
statement: Return the squares of the numbers sorted in non-decreasing order.
starter_code:
def sorted_squares(nums):
    return sorted(n * n for n in nums)

title: Longest Common Prefix
statement: Return the longest prefix shared by all strings in the list.

title: Count Vowels
statement: Count how many vowels appear in the string.
starter_code:
def count_vowels(s):
    return sum(1 for char in s.lower() if char in 'aeiou')

title: Reverse Words
statement: Reverse the order of words in a sentence.

title: Chunk Array
statement: Split the array into chunks of size k.
starter_code:
def chunk_array(nums, size):
    return [nums[index:index + size] for index in range(0, len(nums), size)]

title: Detect Duplicates
statement: Return true when the array contains any duplicate value.

title: Capitalize Sentence
statement: Return the sentence with the first letter capitalized and the rest unchanged.

title: Count Words
statement: Count the number of words in a sentence.
